name: Repository Intelligence Foundation
summary: Introduces Repository Intelligence as a canonical, searchable inventory of the deployable platform package with critical-file integrity validation and full subsystem registry integration.
changes: Added Repository Intelligence runtime service and canonical repository registry.
Added automatic validation of required critical platform files and duplicate repository paths.
Added Repository Intelligence to Platform Doctor diagnostics and the Platform Intelligence subsystem inventory.
Updated Project Brain roadmap and backlog to record the completed Repository Intelligence foundation.
Strengthened subsystem and platform contracts for repository metadata consistency.
